description: Rename a passkey so it is recognisable in the security screen (e.g. 'Work laptop'). Pass the passkey id from get_passkeys. Cosmetic only — it cannot add, remove, or weaken a credential. Send an empty label to clear it back to the provider name.

id.description: The passkey id, as returned by get_passkeys (`id` field)

label.description: New nickname, max 40 characters. Empty or null clears it.

target.description: WALLET for a smart-account passkey (what get_passkeys lists), LOGIN for an email login passkey

name: set_passkey_label
